components.css: .ds-content-card{max-width:28rem;padding:24px;border:1px solid rgba(26,4,86,.12);border-radius:1.35rem;background:#fdfdff;color:#1a0456;font-family:Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;transition:transform 220ms ease,box-shadow 220ms ease}.ds-content-card:hover,.ds-content-card:focus-within{transform:perspective(700px) rotateX(1deg) translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 26px 60px rgba(255,70,146,.18)}.ds-content-card h3{margin:10px 0;font-size:1.06rem;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-content-card p{margin:0;color:#6b6b6b;line-height:1.68}.ds-card-label{color:#e40d7c!important;font-size:.76rem!important;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.15em}

components.name: Symbiotic O
components.description: Two offset ring halves: Signal Pink above, white below, while retaining an accessible O.

narrative.overview: A controlled transition from a deep, focused technology space to understandable action. Navy creates concentration, Signal Pink marks energy and transition, and white protects readability. Human, knowledge, processes and agents appear as one steerable system.
keyCharacteristics: Deep Everience navy instead of a generic neutral SaaS canvas
CI pink used as a scarce signal rather than a default text color
Large responsive Poppins typography with a -0.04em tracking floor
One dominant motion event per viewport
Real motion assets with controlled loading and decoding
rules: Signal Pink marks action, transition or a brand moment.
Small text on white uses Action Pink or Interface Navy, never Signal Pink.
Cards remain flat at rest; elevation responds to interaction.
Brand marks do not float forever.
The Symbiotic O always has a pink upper half and white lower half.
landingpage.html is canonical; vercel-static/index.html is generated.
dos: Separate hero, Human+Technology and conclusion into distinct motion jobs.
Load heavy sequences near the viewport and show an immediate poster.
Give every hover interaction touch and reduced-motion behavior.
Use Signal Pink for action, transition and rare brand moments.
Keep the Everience mark still between interactions.
Test desktop hover, touch return, reduced motion and Vercel asset paths.
donts: Do not compose a generic AI SaaS page from repeated purple glows and card grids.
Do not make multiple animations compete for attention.
Do not rely on hover as the only interaction path.
Do not create scroll traps or pinned decoration that hides content.
Do not use editorial italics as a shortcut for premium branding.
Do not create new cards with 32px or larger radii.
Do not edit generated Vercel output directly.
